_comment: Spec files permitted to skip every test they contain during a post-deploy run.
This is a RATCHET, not an escape hatch. Every line here is a standing admission
that one more spec file cannot verify production, and it is reviewed as such.
The number should go down over time, never quietly up.
Paths are RELATIVE TO playwright's testDir (tests/e2e), exactly as they appear
in the JSON report: "smoke.spec.ts", "routes/clubs.spec.ts". A repo-root path
A file NOT listed here must execute at least one test, or
scripts/ci/assert-e2e-actually-ran.mjs fails the run and names it.
Adding a line requires a reason that says WHAT is missing, not that it skipped.
